audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft translation closely follows the supplied Hebrew; divine name rendered as YHWH. Variant in v.8 and unusually large numeric totals flagged for witness review.

verses.restored: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and he strengthened himself against Israel.

familiar.text: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

modern.text: Asa’s son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place, and he strengthened himself against Israel.

original.text: וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֖ק עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: And he placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim which Asa his father had taken.

familiar.text: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

modern.text: He stationed troops in every fortified city of Judah and put garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

original.text: וַיִּ֨תֶּן חַ֔יִל בְּכָל עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה הַבְּצֻר֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֤ן נְצִיבִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְעָרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד אָסָ֥א אָבִֽיו

verses.restored: And YHWH was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the early ways of his father David, and did not seek the Baals.

familiar.text: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

modern.text: Now the LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David. He did not seek out the Baals,

original.text: וַיְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י הָלַ֗ךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֞י דָּוִ֤יד אָבִיו֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א דָרַ֖שׁ לַבְּעָלִֽים

verses.restored: But he sought YHWH, the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

familiar.text: But sought to the Lord God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

modern.text: but he sought the God of his father and walked by His commandments rather than the practices of Israel.

original.text: כִּ֠י לֵֽאלֹהֵ֤י אָבִיו֙ דָּרָ֔שׁ וּבְמִצְוֺתָ֖יו הָלָ֑ךְ וְלֹ֖א כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Therefore YHWH established the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought presents to Jehoshaphat, so that he had riches and honour in abundance.

familiar.text: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

modern.text: So the LORD established the kingdom in his hand, and all Judah brought him tribute, so that he had an abundance of riches and honor.

original.text: וַיָּ֨כֶן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיִּתְּנ֧וּ כָל יְהוּדָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וַֽיְהִי ל֥וֹ עֹֽשֶׁר וְכָב֖וֹד לָרֹֽב

verses.restored: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of YHWH: moreover he removed the high places and the Asherim from Judah.

familiar.text: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

modern.text: And his heart took delight in the ways of the LORD; furthermore, he removed the high places and Asherah poles from Judah.

original.text: וַיִּגְבַּ֥הּ לִבּ֖וֹ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְע֗וֹד הֵסִ֛יר אֶת הַבָּמ֥וֹת וְאֶת הָאֲשֵׁרִ֖ים מִיהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: And in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes — to Ben‑Hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah — to teach in the cities of Judah.

familiar.text: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

modern.text: In the third year of his reign, Jehoshaphat sent his officials Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah to teach in the cities of Judah,

original.text: וּבִשְׁנַ֨ת שָׁל֜וֹשׁ לְמָלְכ֗וֹ שָׁלַ֤ח לְשָׂרָיו֙ לְבֶן חַ֨יִל֙ וּלְעֹבַדְיָ֣ה וְלִזְכַרְיָ֔ה וְלִנְתַנְאֵ֖ל וּלְמִיכָיָ֑הוּ לְלַמֵּ֖ד בְּעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: And with them the Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, (and Shmiramoth / Shemiramoth), Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadoni‑jah — Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram the priests.

familiar.text: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Hebrew manuscripts show bracketed/variant reading וּשְׁמִירָמ֡וֹת (Shmiramoth / Shemiramoth); see witness note.

modern.text: accompanied by certain Levites—Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah—along with the priests Elishama and Jehoram.

original.text: וְעִמָּהֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֗ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָ֡הוּ וּנְתַנְיָ֡הוּ וּזְבַדְיָ֡הוּ וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֡ל ושמרימות וִֽיהוֹנָתָן֩ וַאֲדֹ֨נִיָּ֧הוּ וְטֽוֹבִיָּ֛הוּ וְט֥וֹב אֲדוֹנִיָּ֖ה הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וִֽיהוֹרָ֖ם הַכֹּהֲנִֽים

verses.restored: And they taught in Judah; and they had the book of the law of YHWH with them, and went about through all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

familiar.text: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

modern.text: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the LORD. They went throughout the towns of Judah and taught the people.

original.text: וַֽיְלַמְּדוּ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְעִ֨מָּהֶ֔ם סֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ בְּכָל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיְלַמְּד֖וּ בָּעָֽם

verses.restored: And the fear of YHWH fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

familiar.text: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

modern.text: And the dread of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that surrounded Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י פַּ֣חַד יְהוָ֗ה עַ֚ל כָּל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיב֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עִם יְהוֹשָׁפָֽט

verses.restored: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and tribute of silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks — seven thousand seven hundred rams, and seven thousand seven hundred he‑goats.

familiar.text: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.

modern.text: Some Philistines also brought gifts and silver as tribute to Jehoshaphat, and the Arabs brought him 7,700 rams and 7,700 goats from their flocks.

original.text: וּמִן פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים מְבִיאִ֧ים לִֽיהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט מִנְחָ֖ה וְכֶ֣סֶף מַשָּׂ֑א גַּ֣ם הָֽעַרְבִיאִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֥ים לוֹ֙ צֹ֕אן אֵילִ֔ים שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וּשְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וּתְיָשִׁ֕ים שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת

verses.restored: And Jehoshaphat became great exceedingly; and he built in Judah fortresses and store‑cities.

familiar.text: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.

modern.text: Jehoshaphat grew stronger and stronger, and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah

original.text: וַיְהִ֧י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְגָדֵ֖ל עַד לְמָ֑עְלָה וַיִּ֧בֶן בִּֽיהוּדָ֛ה בִּירָנִיּ֖וֹת וְעָרֵ֥י מִסְכְּנֽוֹת

verses.restored: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

modern.text: and kept vast supplies in the cities of Judah. He also had warriors in Jerusalem who were mighty men of valor.

original.text: וּמְלָאכָ֥ה רַבָּ֛ה הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאַנְשֵׁ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: Now these are the numbering of them, by the house of their fathers: of Judah, the captains of thousands — Adnah the chief; and with him mighty men of valour, three hundred thousand.

familiar.text: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

modern.text: These are their numbers according to the houses of their fathers: From Judah, the commanders of thousands: Adnah the commander, and with him 300,000 mighty men of valor;

original.text: וְאֵ֥לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם לִֽיהוּדָה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י אֲלָפִ֔ים עַדְנָ֣ה הַשָּׂ֔ר וְעִמּוֹ֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אָֽלֶף

verses.restored: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand.

familiar.text: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.

modern.text: next to him, Jehohanan the commander, and with him 280,000;

original.text: וְעַל יָד֖וֹ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַשָּׂ֑ר וְעִמּ֕וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָֽלֶף

verses.restored: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto YHWH; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

familiar.text: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

modern.text: and next to him, Amasiah son of Zichri, the volunteer for the LORD, and with him 200,000 mighty men of valor.

original.text: וְעַל יָדוֹ֙ עֲמַסְיָ֣ה בֶן זִכְרִ֔י הַמִּתְנַדֵּ֖ב לַיהוָ֑ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָֽיִל

verses.restored: And of Benjamin: Eliada a mighty man of valour; and with him armed men, bowmen and shield‑bearers, two hundred thousand.

familiar.text: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

modern.text: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him 200,000 armed with bows and shields;

original.text: וּמִ֨ן בִּנְיָמִ֔ן גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֖יִל אֶלְיָדָ֑ע וְעִמּ֛וֹ נֹֽשְׁקֵי קֶ֥שֶׁת וּמָגֵ֖ן מָאתַ֥יִם אָֽלֶף

verses.restored: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and eighty thousand, ready prepared for the war.

familiar.text: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.

modern.text: and next to him, Jehozabad, and with him 180,000 armed for battle.

original.text: וְעַל יָד֖וֹ יְהוֹזָבָ֑ד וְעִמּ֛וֹ מֵאָֽה וּשְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא

verses.restored: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king set in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

familiar.text: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.

modern.text: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.

original.text: אֵ֖לֶּה הַמְשָׁרְתִ֣ים אֶת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ מִלְּבַ֞ד אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ בְּעָרֵ֥י הַמִּבְצָ֖ר בְּכָל יְהוּדָֽה

translation_notes: Divine name יהוה rendered uniformly as YHWH.
Preserves literal structure and names; does not harmonize discrepant numbers or bracketed reading in v.8.
